body.name: Calibrated transition-robust confidence fiber
body.construction: Build \(C_n\) from Bonferroni-calibrated two-sided Clopper--Pearson cell intervals with total error \(\beta_n=\min\{n^{-2},\alpha/2\}\). For each \(t\in[0,1]^2\), compute the profile deviance \(\Delta_n(t)\), take the supremum of its exact replicate tail probability over \(q\in C_n\) satisfying \(t\in\mathcal T(q)\), add \(\beta_n\), truncate at one, and set \(K_n=\{t:\operatorname{pv}_n(t)>\alpha\}\).
